ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement"), made as of the Xday of MaY, 2013, by and between 1039 FULTON LLC., a New York limited liability company ("Owner"), having an address at c/o G-Way Management LLC, 839 Classon Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11238 and THE FULTON HILL CORNER, LLC, a New York limited liability company, (Developer"), a New York limited liability company, having an address at 936 Fulton Street, Brooklyn, New York 11238. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner represents that it is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, County of Kings,City and State of New York, known as Lots 10 and 11 in Block 1992 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings, and known as and by the street addresses of 1039 Fulton Street and 1039A Fulton Street, and more particularly described in Exhibit "A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Owner Land"; the building located thereon is herein referred to as the "Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the "OwnerProperty"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, if any, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, County of Kings, City and State of New York, known as Lots 12, 13, 15 and 16 in Block 1992 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings, and known as and by the street addresses of 1037 Fulton Street and Downing Street (with a number to be assigned), and more particularly described on Exhibit "B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Developer Land"; the building and improvements thereon are herein referred to as the "Existing Developer Building"); WHEREAS, the Owner Property and the Developer Property (as hereinafter defined) are being merged into a single zoning lot under Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS,Developer intends to demolish the Existing Developer Building, if any, and construct a new building,all or a portion of which will be on the Developer Land, and to construct other improvements associated with such new building (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the "Developer Building"; and the Developer Land and the Existing Developer Building or the Developer Building are herein collectively referred to as the "Developer Property"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution, than is now available for use on the Owner Property pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the “Unused Development Rights” (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to the 1
